## What is KITTY CORP?

KITTY CORP is an India-founded technology company developing Physical-World Intelligence: AI systems that connect perception, software and machines to practical environments. Its work spans AI robotics, agricultural field systems, clean-energy intelligence and commercial digital engineering.

## Research and initiatives

- **KITTY AgriYaan** — an agricultural autonomous rover initiative exploring crop monitoring, terrain mobility, field sensing and edge-computer vision. Current work is at simulation and kinematics stage; it is not represented as a field-deployed product.
- **KITTY UrjaYaan** — a clean-energy intelligence initiative focused on solar monitoring, energy optimisation, predictive telemetry and extending solar infrastructure's useful life. Current work includes algorithmic modelling.
- **KITTY AI** — a vision-and-control software stack under active development, intended to bridge spatial perception, edge inference and robotic actuators.
- **KITTY Buddy** — an exploratory physical AI companion concept focused on voice interaction and tangible human-machine interaction.

## Digital Solutions Studio

KITTY CORP also provides commercial digital engineering services to fund and support its longer-term R&D. Services include:
- Business websites and web development
- Applications and custom software
- AI agents and workflow automation
- API integrations and business systems

Commercial services and demos: https://demo.thekittycorp.com

## How KITTY CORP generates revenue

Commercial project work through its Digital Solutions Studio—websites, applications, custom software, AI automation and integrations—generates client revenue. This is separate from the company's research initiatives.

KITTY CORP is an early-stage technology team. Descriptions of research initiatives reflect their current development stage; they should not be interpreted as claims of completed commercial deployment or field validation.
